mechanism: Both diclofenac and curcumin (turmeric's active compound) inhibit platelet aggregation and possess anticoagulant properties, increasing bleeding risk; turmeric may also inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing diclofenac levels.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; counsel patient to avoid concurrent use or space administration; consider alternative pain management if prolonged turmeric supplementation planned.
